The '''Imperial Starport Registry''' was a publication produced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with information on [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. It was made available to anyone with a legitimate [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] license.
